title: Mirror with Six Circular Flowers
text_changes: None; translated fields and remarks reproduced verbatim

passages.text:
[This mirror can unveil one's] gall.
It can fathom the hidden and the subtle.
Its clarity and lustre put the pearl to shame,
And the moon to pale.
[Now] that the war has ended,
Let's celebrate the rising fortune at the wake.
passages.source_text:
【】【】【】膽，知幽察微。珠慚朗潤，
月謝光輝。【】兵既弭，福慶斯歸。

note: Complete museum-published inscription rendering; AncientLens scholarly review remains unreviewed. Six lines of transcription and six corresponding English lines cover the outer inscription band; square gaps and editorial supplements are retained.
